about: The F32 reference of the Muse-Glimmer real-weight continuation gate: each distinct legacy continuation of LegacyReal/*.json teacher-forced from its golden prompt, the top 10 log-probabilities of every step.
method: managed backend, StandardDecoderModel.FloatProductsForTests (every block-format product: exactly dequantized weights times F32 rows), F32 KV cache, F32 activations; the prompt but its last token, then that token and the continuation as one scored chunk (row i predicts continuation token i)
